tema:
Tema:o mistério da Ilha esquecida

Narração: inglês 

Protagonista: um homem com barba 48 anos
legenda: Ele entrou em uma ilha esquecida para salvar o irmão, mas algo misterioso o esperava lá dentro. O final dessa jornada vai te surpreender! 👁️ Você encararia esse mistério ou fugiria correndo? Responda nos comentários! #Terror #Mistério #HistoriasAssustadoras #IlhaEsquecida
falas: Arthur stepped onto the fog-shrouded forgotten island to rescue his missing brother before the tide sealed them in forever.
Deep inside the ancient forest, he discovered rusty iron cages dangling from massive black trees, swaying without any wind.
Suddenly, heavy footsteps echoed behind him, but when he turned around, only strange glowing symbols marked the muddy ground.
Inside a ruined stone watchtower, he found his brother's lantern still burning brightly beside a fresh, warm cup of tea.
A chilling shadow detached itself from the wall, silently mimicking his exact movements like a distorted dark reflection.
The shadow pointed towards a hidden trapdoor, revealing a glowing underground staircase echoing with his brother's distant voice.
He heard steps climbing up toward him from the dark depth. Would you descend into the pit or run back?
